Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V)]] (original printing), game text: “While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. Immune to Fire Extinguisher.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
